{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out invalid age records (age < 0)
valid_age_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Filter for customers who converted and have valid age
converted_valid_age = valid_age_df[valid_age_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers with valid age
mean_age_converted = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Count of converted customers with valid age
n_converted_valid = len(converted_valid_age)

# Also compute the number of valid age records (for evidence)
n_valid_age = len(valid_age_df)

# Print all necessary numbers
print(f"Number of customers with valid age (age >= 0): {n_valid_age}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {n_converted_valid}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age_converted}")"}
